title: Furniture: the interiors' pieces
about: Every kind of src/sim/interiors/furniture.js (67: a flat's, a stairwell's, shops', a bakery's, a bar's, an office's and an embassy's) as src/art/furniture.js draws it, at the game's camera and scale (the fine finish, 640 × 360): boxes in whole pixels with painted faces, the detail on the tops and fronts that the camera sees, sides and backs painted for pieces turned. A contact sheet a page at a time, each kind labelled on the floor, a person in each row for scale; the turned page shows pieces facing up, left and right. Then the pieces together: a flat (living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hall) over a corner shop, a bakery and a café-bar, by day and by night (lamps with their pools, the TV, the fridges, the oven's fire, the back bar's light).
